verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a bulk operation capability, such as multi-select edits, batch moves or completions, or batch API endpoints. Everything Views only aggregate items of one type onto a single page for viewing. The REST API's pagination and X-Total-Count header, the CLI/MCP mentions and templates are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
